stylePrompt: Mature learner-facing educational illustration, landscape 3:2, one clear focal meaning, refined gouache, watercolor or naturalist editorial style with visible brushwork, no photographic or live-action impression, no in-image teaching text, letters, numbers, labels, interfaces, logos or watermarks.
